## Classification-based Policy Iteration

@Lagoudakis2003-kz proposed an classification-based policy iteration that uses classifiers such as SVM and neural networks to approximate the policy. 

@Lazaric2016-gg introduced cost-sensitive loss function weighting each classification mistake by its actual regret.
